name: M7.QuotientDegree.quotient_equiv
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → Nonempty ((M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N ⧸ M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F) ≃+* AdjoinRoot F)
context:
theorem M7.QuotientDegree.span_containment : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → Ideal.span ({M6.Cyclic.modulus N} : Set M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) ≤ Ideal.span ({F} : Set M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) := by
  intro N _ F hF
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro p hp
  rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp with rfl
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hF
guidance: This is the actual cyclic quotient by the full monic polynomial, with no irreducibility, odd-N or squarefree assumption. Accepted M7.SignatureIdeal.quotient_membership says image p belongs to principal F iff F divides p when F divides modulus. For quotient_equiv define Ideal.Quotient.factor (span_containment N F hF), whose codomain is AdjoinRoot F; factor_surjective and factor_mk are current APIs. Show its kernel equals principal F by mk_surjective on the cyclic quotient, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero and quotient_membership. Then RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective gives the equivalence. AdjoinRoot is the quotient by span singleton. adjoin_card: (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hF).basis.equivFun identifies AdjoinRoot F with Fin F.natDegree → ZMod 2, preserving the degree zero case F=1. Use Nat.card_congr and finite function cardinality. Ideal.quotientEquiv I J e h expects h : J = I.map e.toRingHom, reverse the displayed hypothesis. Apply quotient_card on both sides and injectivity of 2^n on naturals. This generic intermediate automorphism lemma will later be instantiated with the proved actual unit substitution, not assumed in the M7 root. Return tactic lines only.
